niche: a prairie retail co-operative's release detection for the underground tank systems at its gas bars: which tank systems go on the January 2027 tightness-testing work order because product is escaping to the ground at more than 0.75 litres an hour, when a pressurised line that leaks only while its pump runs loses product in step with sales exactly as worn dispenser meters do
answer: GB-131 Ituna regular (1.2 L/h) and GB-134 Canora regular (0.9 L/h) go on the January 2027 tightness-testing work order
analyst_test: A strong analyst who builds each gas bar tank system's October to December book correctly and runs statistical inventory reconciliation, the field's release detection method, files Ituna regular alone: the reconciliation books Canora regular's 1.0 L/h shortfall, which moves with its sales, to the dispenser meters as ordinary wear inside the in-service tolerance; it is wrong because Canora's meters were calibrated on 2 July 2026 and have passed too few litres since to give away more than 0.1 L/h at the drift the network's own tank books show.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each underground tank system's release of product to the ground, estimated the way storage tank release detection estimates it, by reconciling daily tank gauge inventories against metered sales and deliveries; with another field's nouns there is no pressurised product line that loses product only while its submersible pump runs and no dispenser meter that drifts toward over-delivery with the litres it passes, so the separation the call turns on does not exist.

driver: A loss that rises with the volume a unit dispenses is read by the field's reconciliation as its measuring devices over-delivering, but those devices drift only with the volume they have passed since their last adjustment, at a rate the population's own history shows, so a unit whose volume-linked loss runs above what its devices' throughput since adjustment explains is losing product along a path that operates only while it dispenses, and two units with the same volume-linked loss can be one worn and one leaking.
driver_concrete: Each gas bar tank system's book shortfall that moves with its litres sold is booked by statistical inventory reconciliation to the dispenser meters, but the co-op's meters drift toward over-delivery with the litres they pass after each calibration, at one rate per litre read across every tank system's 2024 to 2026 quarters, so Canora's regular, calibrated in July with a sales-linked loss several times what its meters' 124,000 litres a hose since explain, is losing product from its pressurised line while the pump runs, and Kamsack's regular, with a like share of sales lost on 984,000 litres a hose since April 2025, is only worn meters; a drift clocked in months instead files Foam Lake's truck-stop diesel, whose hoses pass 4,800 litres a day each.
stump: A competent analyst reconciles each tank system's October to December 2026 book against its gauge closes, splits the shortfall the way statistical inventory reconciliation does (the part that moves with sales to the meters, the constant to a release) and files Ituna regular alone, missing Canora regular, whose pressurised line loses product only while its pump runs; the step that lands it there is reading that system's sales-linked loss as meter error when its meters, calibrated on 2 July, have passed too few litres since to explain it.

differentiation.task121: task121 v4 weighs each candidate driver of a satisfaction fall on the conditions each response was made under; task180 attributes a fuel shortfall that moves with sales to worn meters or a leaking pressurised line by how far the meters have been used since their last calibration

lineage.driver: The referral test is filed for each metered sub-unit against its own history, but the ready-made series sums the sub-units of an entity, and where an entity holds a second sub-unit carrying one seasonal load, a large fall on that sub-unit moves the entity total by a few per cent, inside ordinary variation, so screening the summed series ranks the candidates differently from screening each sub-unit and counting entities once.

lineage.driver: A monitored signal that the standard reads as the unit's own fault can be carried in from an attached compartment whose ordinary operation produces it, so ranking units on the signal measured in the main body puts units with a leaking neighbour ahead of units with genuine internal faults; only attributing each unit's signal to its source, by its co-movement with the neighbour's operations and its composition, separates them.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-11 at hardening loop 1 on paper: round 6 landed (proxy 81.6) with a self-controlled case series over all observed time; filing the comparison for the literal-determinism rule makes the decisive step rule application, and the separation determinism needs is the same symptom that hands the step over
lineage.driver: A suspected effect of starting a treatment is tested by comparing the people who start it with people who do not, but the people who start it are chosen for a reason that already carries the outcome, a trait no recorded variable captures, so the comparison, adjusted for everything recorded, names the treatment its users were already at risk under; only comparing each person's outcomes in the window just after starting with the same person's other time, which cancels every fixed trait, finds the treatment that changes the outcome.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 2 on measurement: the decisive construction was one group-by on the local hour plus one multiply and one divide, identical to the cheapest route at correlation 1.00000000 over eight redraws by twenty cells, and its count form filed the same call from two files; the shipped pack (delivered 2026-10-12, pending review) failed Gate F in an in-house blind read; re-rooted 2026-11-02 to architecture 5 in a new world
lineage.driver: An event enters the record only when it rises above the noise at the instruments, and where that noise follows a daily cycle the smallest events are recorded only in the quiet hours, so a unit's record understates its small events by the share of the day they are masked while its size distribution still passes the usual completeness tests; when a forward change removes the masking, the unit's count rises to its true rate, which only its quiet-hour record or its fully recorded sizes reveal.
lineage.why: Screen 2 by exact identity: the designed construction equals the one-group-by route at correlation 1.00000000 with a maximum absolute difference of 0.000e+00 over eight world redraws by twenty cells, so nothing is estimated between the group-by and the golden, and in its count form it files the same call reading only two files. The ladder's dominance is the factor by which the located hour profile departs from flat, to 4.441e-16. The lever is not on the dial that moves legibility: the golden's margin stays 1.802 to 1.886 across the whole sweep while legibility runs 1.213 to 3.278, and of 76 settings only 3 are floor-compliant with the shipped pack the quietest. The re-root needs an estimation step inside the decisive step, so that paying the entry price is not the whole of the work.

notes: Re-root of task180 to architecture 5, drawn 2026-11-02 in a new world (a Canadian prairie retail co-operative, underground fuel tank release detection), new dataset, new generator and a new prompt shell (architecture 4's which | answer | give | docx+xlsx is in lineage_shells; this one is which | deliverable-led | figures-led | pdf+xlsx). Anomaly Detection & Diagnostics: the anomaly is a tank system releasing product to the ground; the artefact it must be told from is dispenser meters that over-deliver as they wear, because both make the book shortfall move with litres sold. The decisive step is an estimate: each tank system's expected meter over-delivery in the quarter from each hose's litres since its last calibration, at one drift per litre fitted across every tank system's earlier quarters. calibration_form none: no meter inspection results ship, only the service work orders that date each calibration. WARN repeat.decision answered: the decision unit is the tank system and the work order covers a set. WARN repeat.gate_g (task232 v2, re-rooted to decomposition_attribution on 2026-11-01): the label is honest here, a book shortfall assigned to meter wear or a release, and the split is not task232's interviewer roster effect. Structural NOTEs (task470, task107 v2, task121 v4) carry differentiation lines.
